attribute_fields.COMMENTS: South Carolina military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt. National Guard drill pay withholding optional.

action_details.action_comment: No military retirement pay - no exclusion
action_details.action_dsl: /* No military retirement pay - no exclusion. */

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates South Carolina state income tax. SC has progressive tax brackets: 0% up to $3,560, 3% from $3,561-$17,830, and 6% above $17,830. SC standard deduction is $15,000 (Single) or $30,000 (MFJ).

action_details.action_comment: Publish state result to the generic computed_state_tax fields
action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.sc_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.sc_state_tax
action_details.action_postfix: result.sc_taxable_income cvi /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.sc_state_tax cvi /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: SC state income tax calculated per SC DOR 2025 progressive brackets
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "SC state income tax calculated per SC DOR 2025 progressive brackets"

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Picks the SC standard deduction matching the filing_status and stores sc_taxable_income = max(agi - deduction, 0). Run from SC_Tax_Brackets's initial_action before bracket evaluation. Replaces a context body that used postfix ifelse to choose the deduction.

condition_details.condition_comment: Joint filing status uses the joint standard deduction
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

action_details.action_dsl: set result.sc_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - sc_standard_deduction_joint) and 0
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi sc_standard_deduction_joint f- 0 fmax cvd /result.sc_taxable_income xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.sc_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - sc_standard_deduction_single) and 0
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi sc_standard_deduction_single f- 0 fmax cvd /result.sc_taxable_income xdef

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Applies SC progressive tax brackets. Brackets: 0% up to $3,560, 3% from $3,561-$17,830, 6% above $17,830. Same brackets for all filing statuses.

condition_details.condition_comment: In bracket 1 only (0%); sc_taxable_income at or below sc_bracket_1_limit
In bracket 2 (3%); sc_taxable_income at or below sc_bracket_2_limit
Zero or negative taxable income; sc_taxable_income at or below 0

action_details.action_postfix: result.sc_taxable_income sc_bracket_1_limit f- sc_bracket_2_rate fmul cvi /result.sc_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.sc_state_tax = (sc_bracket_2_limit - sc_bracket_1_limit) * sc_bracket_2_rate + (result.sc_taxable_income - sc_bracket_2_limit) * sc_bracket_3_rate
action_details.action_postfix: sc_bracket_2_limit sc_bracket_1_limit f- sc_bracket_2_rate fmul result.sc_taxable_income sc_bracket_2_limit f- sc_bracket_3_rate fmul f+ cvi /result.sc_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: SC tax: $428.10 base + 6% on income above $17,830
